## LoginPage
- **Import:** `../../pages/generalPages/loginPage.js`
- **Iframe:** top-level page
- **Properties:**
  - `userIdInput` — selector: `[data-test="login-user-id-field"]`
  - `passwordInput` — selector: `[data-test="login-password-field"]`
  - `loginButton` — selector: `[data-test="login-sign-in"]`
- **Methods:**
  - `fillLoginForm(email, password)` — fills email and password fields
  - `submitLoginForm()` — clicks the login button
  - `login()` — full login flow using env vars (`ZO_ROOT_USER_EMAIL`, `ZO_ROOT_USER_PASSWORD`); 🌐 network-aware: waitForResponse('**/auth/login**'); ⏱ timing-aware: waitForTimeout(1000ms + 2000ms)
  - `gotoLoginPage()` — navigates to the base login URL
